text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty INC-2026 fired — high 5xx rate on inference-gateway-us-west1 (alert threshold breached) :rotating_light:
incidentbot: summary: 5xx spike started ~9056788990, rate 12% -> 35% over 5m, elevated error budget risk. linked runbook: https://go/runbooks/inference-5xx
sam: acked. I'm on it — triaging now.
carla: tagging support for customer impact check @support-lead
sam: quick snapshot: errors are HTTP 502/504 from gateway -> kvcache proxy timed out; backend model shards returning 200 but gateway times out on aggregation path. Region: us-west1 only.
carla: support-lead — any active customer tickets from USW?
support-lead: a couple customers reported increased latency but no new outage tickets yet. CS monitoring flagged slow response times for a high-volume account.
ben: past incidents showed kvcache evictions can cascade. Sam, can you check kvcache metrics and sidecar restarts?
sam: diving into host metrics. kvcache eviction rate up 10x, CPU on proxy nodes spiking. rolling restart of proxy sidecar on a problematic AZ helped previously. Attempting restart on pod inference-proxy-12 now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-proxy -n prod-usw1 --selector=az=us-west1-b`
incidentbot: automatic mitigation suggestion: apply cache-warmup and reduce route weight to us-west1 by 50% for 10m. CLI: `redwood route modify --region us-west1 --weight 50% --duration 10m`
sam: applied route weight shift to divert traffic, initiating sidecar restart. Monitoring error rate.
carla: putting customer-facing note draft in #support-drafts, will coordinate if impact increases.
ben: if sidecar restarts don't drop errors in 3m, plan B: scale up proxy pool by +2 replicas in us-west1 and temporarily enable fallback-model variant (lower mem) for large requests.
sam: sidecar restart succeeded, kube events show pods recreated. Observed error rate falling to 18% -> 11% in last 2m. latency still elevated for tail.
support-lead: notifying CS to watch the flagged accounts, prepping proactive outreach if we cross 20% error again.
carla: great. Sam — can you capture the traces for last 10m and upload to the incident folder? runbook step 4.
sam: done — traces uploaded: https://go/trace/9056789012. I'm handing off primary on-call to Ben in 25m — I'll stay available.
ben: taking primary in 25m. I'll keep watch on kvcache and the weight-shift rollback trigger. If errors <10% for 10m, we'll start a controlled rollback.
incidentbot: INC-2026 status updated: acknowledged -> mitigated (degraded). Continue monitoring.
carla: filing follow-up ticket for deeper kvcache root cause and capacity tuning. Tags: postmortem, kvcache, proxy-scaling.
support-lead: flagging for postmortem and CS customer comms. Good job team :thumbsup:
ben: noted. I'll perform handoff checks at 25m and escalate to infra if we see new spikes.
carla: last check: are any A/B rollouts or canary traffic going to us-west1 that might have amplified traffic?
sam: confirmed no canaries. Traffic pattern shows a burst from a single heavy client cluster — working with infra to request client-side rate smoothing.
ben: ok, leaving an action: if error rate >15% in next 15m, trigger emergency auto-scale and reweight to 30%.
incidentbot: Thread closed for now — will re-open on further alerts.
